title: Idea Market
tagline: A decentralized collaboration network to Ideate - Build - Fund any idea.
description: Idea marketplace where ideas are a gated dynamic NFT that opens up to different team players (makers/developers, customers, investors, experts) incentivized to progress the idea into the real world.
